meta.units: g_c per dollar of the challenge capital C, g_f and h_f per dollar of the funded capital F, days per purchase

exit.note: a model, not a measurement; days after a request for a share of the pool's value, intake closed, paid from idle capital first and then as seats end (seatsim.exit_wait)

tail.note: measured, not modelled: one-minute bars from Bybit over the eight worst crash days since 10 Oct 2025, these rules (3% a day, 6% from the start, 5x), entry at every minute of the day with the watchdog closing a minute later. Hyperliquid itself is not checked -- liquidation there follows an oracle rather than the last trade. The figures are the worst entry of the day with every seat in a full position on the same side: possible, not an expectation. How often a cascade happens is not measured -- there is one in the data.

spread_calm.label: seats spread over the list, the big ones on the calm coins
spread_calm.layout: big seats on the calm coins: BTC 50k, ETH 25k, SOL 3 x 5k

spread_risky.label: seats spread over the list, the big one on the riskiest coin
spread_risky.layout: big seats on the risky coin: SOL 50k, ETH 25k, BTC 3 x 5k

single_coin.label: every seat on the riskiest coin of the list

reference_mix.label: the stress test's pool: two big seats on alts
reference_mix.layout: the stress test's own pool: ADA 50k, AVAX 25k, BNB, BTC, DOGE 5k each

single_coin.label: every seat on the riskiest coin of the list

counts.basis: the stress test's own pool, long, execution at the next open

levers.note: measured, not modelled: the cascade package's own tool (stress/make_levers.py) over the same eight crash days and the same five seats, long side, one cell for each choice of where the stop sits, the leverage and the coins. The leverage is the one the leverage rule v1.2 allows each coin today (BTC and ETH 10x, SOL 5x), or one for every seat; the seats hold 80% of the pool and the rest is its reserve. A stop on the exchange is taken at the line itself; walking the order book is added from a separate measurement of Hyperliquid's book in a calm market. The book in a cascade has not been measured.

lists.wide: one seat on each of the first five coins by name: ADA, AVAX, BNB, BTC, DOGE
lists.default: BTC, ETH and SOL, the big seats on the calm coins: BTC 44.4k, ETH 22.2k, SOL 3 x 4.4k

pool.note: the seats hold this share of the pool and the rest is its reserve; a cell's worst_pct is a share of the seats' capital, its worst_pct_of_pool a share of the whole pool

rule.note: the leverage rule v1.2 of 27 Oct 2026 (rule 22): BTC and ETH 10x, SOL 5x; none of the wide list's alts

book.measured: our own collection of Hyperliquid's public order book (l2Book, mainnet), 34 hourly files of snapshots from 2026-09-25 to 2026-09-27, a calm market; the repository holds the derived bounds and the scripts that derive them, not the raw snapshots
book.note: upper bounds: a seat's notional is priced at the nearest measured size at or above it, on the worse side of the book; the taker fee is already inside the cells, so only walking the book is added
